## Summary

- The Console can define, edit, and run Data Channels: a draft graph on the canvas, published versions, an activation switch, and on-demand or scheduled runs.
- Node types cover triggers, For frames, dataset query and materialize, Entity writes, webhooks, email, code, and live Source queries. Run-scoped datasets live in entity-database schema `channel_dataset` and expire with the run.
- Webhooks and Email Accounts are site-wide catalogs that channel nodes call.
- A channel run reads and writes Entity rows as User `system`. That User holds one locked grant on every published Entity. The grant cannot be edited, disabled, or revoked. Existing grants stay editable.
- `super_admin` receives the new channel, webhook, and email-account permissions. `operator` and custom Roles do not until an administrator adds them.
- User, Role, and Source lists accept a search string. Console module identity includes an icon.

## Operator notes

- Upgrade from v0.1.10. v0.1.9 was tagged but its release failed to build; skip it.
- No new keys in `.env.example`. Leave the live `.env` in place. `ENTITY_OWNER_PASSWORD` and `ENTITY_READER_PASSWORD` remain required, URL-safe, and distinct.
- Compose still mounts named volume `refraq_pg` at `/var/lib/postgresql`. Default PGDATA is `/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker`. A site already on that mount, including one upgraded through v0.1.10, keeps its cluster. A site that only used the published v0.1.8 asset must still copy the anonymous-volume cluster onto `refraq_pg` before `up -d`, using the command in the v0.1.10 notes. Do not run `docker compose down -v`.
- Replace `docker-compose.yaml`, then `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. The new image tag recreates `ensure-entity-db`. That one-shot creates schema `channel_dataset` before api and worker start. Those processes refuse to start while `entity_data`, `entity_access`, `acl`, or `channel_dataset` is missing.
- API start runs Foundation Upgrade from `0055_channel_definitions` through `0067_execution_container`. The new tables are empty. Existing metadata and Entity rows stay.
- Upgrade inserts User account `system` (id `usr_system`) when that id is absent, and one locked grant for each `all_clear` profile. The User has no password and cannot sign in. User lists omit it. If another User already uses account `system`, the migration stops on the unique account. Rename that account before upgrading.
- Data Channel System Parameters are seeded with defaults and need no operator step: `channel_run_record_retention_days` 30, `channel_dataset_retention_days` 7, `channel_dataset_success_retention_hours` 24, `channel_dataset_max_total_gb` 100.
- Rolling back to an older compose after these migrations and the entity bootstrap is not supported.
